name: jev-toolkit-compiler
description: Claude Code mod built on a judgement model (TypeSafe Jev): compact/clear advice and a searchable log of past sessions.

plugins.name: jev-context
plugins.description: Advises when a big context is worth compacting or clearing, and searches a log of past sessions. Advice only; shares one judge request with jev-router when both are installed. Needs the jev-toolkit-compiler and jev-toolkit-usage Python packages installed.
